# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** nine-year-old (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Anne-girl P9](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0009)</sub>  
  _previously: 7 (v2)_  <sub>[v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034), [v3 ch.Change P32](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0032)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Davy Keith is characterized by a round head covered in a crop of fuzzy little yellow ringlets, paired with a snub nose. He has a dimple in only one cheek, giving him a comical, lopsided look when he laughs, and he has recently grown a whole inch.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v3 ch.Revelation P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006)_

## Personality

Davy Keith is a mischievous and heedless young boy known for his lively curiosity and inquisitive nature, though he has also been described as a reformed character. Lacking imagination, he takes a very practical approach to life, even if he remains quite forgetful of rules and instructions. His personal ambitions include living to be a hundred years old and becoming a storekeeper who keeps an abundance of candy and bananas.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P14](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0014), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P30](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0030), +7 more_

## History

Davy Keith was born an orphan after losing his father as a baby and going without cake for a long time during his mother's illness. Following a long conversation with his mother the night before she died, Davy and his twin sister, [Dora](../character/dora.md), were taken in for the winter by [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Unaccustomed to proper bringing up, Davy quickly gained a reputation for wild antics, such as dropping a caterpillar down a church attendee's neck, forcing [Dora](../character/dora.md) to walk a pigpen fence, and hiding a toad in Marilla's bed. He also locked [Dora](../character/dora.md) inside Mr. Harrison's toolhouse, though he broke down in tears over his falsehoods when confronted by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Despite his misbehavior, including eating lemon pies intended for a famous visiting author and struggling with bedtime prayers, [Anne](../character/anne.md) consistently guided him with patience. The twins' stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) became permanent after their relative [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) died and left them a trust fund. As he grew older, Davy continued to act out by cutting up Dora's aprons, scaring Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) with a jack-o'-lantern, and chasing her rooster until it died. On one occasion, he convinced [Dora](../character/dora.md) to skip [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) to go fishing with the [Cottons](../codex/factions.md#cottons) and lied to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), but his guilty conscience eventually drove him to confess to [Anne](../character/anne.md) late at night so she could encourage him to seek forgiveness. Over the years, Davy remained an enthusiastic presence at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), eagerly welcoming [Anne](../character/anne.md) home from [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) during her visits, chattering about his lost tooth, complaining about his arithmetic schoolwork, and looking forward to future marriage plans.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P1](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0001), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P4](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0004), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P6](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0006), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P8](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0008), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P9](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0009), +881 more_

## Quotes

> "I just did it for fun. Things have been so awful quiet here for so long that I thought it would be fun to give you folks a big scare. It was, too."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P43](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0043)

> “I never will, now that I know it’s bad,” asseverated Davy between sobs. “If you ever catch me telling a whopper again you can . . .” Davy groped mentally for a suitable penance . . . “you can skin me alive, Anne.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P56](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0056)

> “Why?” queried Davy, settling comfortably down and looking up with a tearstained, investigating face. “Why ain’t whopper as good as falsehood? I want to know. It’s just as big a word.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P58](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0058)

> “Then,” said Davy decidedly, “Marilla is bad, for she tells them. And she’s worse’n me, for I didn’t know it was wrong but she does.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P68](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0068)

> “I’ll do it,” volunteered Davy, “if Marilla’ll hold them by the legs, ’cause I guess it’d take both my hands to manage the axe. It’s awful jolly fun to see them hopping about after their heads are cut off.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P21](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0021)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--davy-keith.md)

[Anne](../character/anne.md) serves as a gentle mentor and household guardian to Davy after he comes to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Though she holds authority over him and often has to deal with his rowdy antics and misbehavior, she acts as a loving companion who guides his moral upbringing. Davy frequently turns to her to confess his pranks or seek comfort, and [Anne](../character/anne.md) affectionately shields and educates him.

- Student of — teacher helping to bring him up  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0030)</sub>
- Serves under — has the authority to boss him (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Transgressors P18](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0018)</sub>
- Friend of — affectionate household companion and mentor (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Again P14](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0014)</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--davy-keith.md)

[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) is a fond companion and maternal figure to Davy at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). She helps manage his mischievous behavior, comforts him when he breaks down over his misdeeds, and provides warm encouragement before leaving for college. Their bond is defined by Anne's patient guidance and Davy's affection for her.

- Friend of — fond companion  <sub>[v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P87](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0087)</sub>

### [Dora](../character/dora.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

[Dora](../character/dora.md) is Davy's twin sister who comes to live with him at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) after their mother's death. Davy frequently targets her with his unruly behavior, such as forcing her to walk a pigpen fence, soaking her with water, and locking her in a neighbor's toolhouse. Despite his mischievous tormenting, the two remain paired as household siblings under Marilla's care.

- Sibling of — twin brother and sister  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P51](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0051), +7 more</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--marilla-cuthbert.md)

[Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is Davy's relative and strict guardian who takes him and his sister in out of a sense of family duty. She establishes authority over Davy, disciplining him for his constant pranks, lying, and lively table manners. Despite the frequent strain caused by his mischievous antics, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) genuinely cares for his upbringing and often laughs over his behavior in private.

- Serves under — guardian who gives orders and disciplines him  <sub>[v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v3 ch.Transgressors P18](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0018)</sub>
- Friend of — caring for him at Green Gables  <sub>[v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012)</sub>
- Relative of — guardian taking care of him  <sub>[v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010)</sub>

### [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--milty-boulter.md)

[Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md) is a local boy with whom Davy shares a personal rivalry regarding their height. Davy occasionally brings up Milty during his conversations at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) while discussing his school life and local peer competition.

- Rival of — rivalry over height (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Revelation P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006)</sub>
